articles.summary: Barrons.com: Financial Stocks Have Had a Wild Week. Citi and 9 More That Look Promising.. Between a Truth Social post from President Donald Trump and fourth-quarter earnings, financial stocks have had a crazy week. The first reason is that Trump posted that he wants to cap interest rates on credit cards at 10% for a year, which would slash rates roughly in half and devastate earnings for card issuers. JPMorgan Chase stock fell Monday in response to its results, while Bank of America Citi group, and Wells Fargo all lost ground after reporting on Tuesday. Related tickers mentioned: C, XLF.
